line: push    esi; Oblivion NiTransformController binary load. Uses generic single-interpolator controller loading, but for stream versions below 0x0A010068 additionally reads a legacy object link that represents NiTransformData.

call    NiSingleInterpController_LoadBinary; Loads NiTimeController state. For stream versions >= 0x0A010068, reads and smart-assigns the serialized interpolator reference at +0x3C; older formats leave concrete controllers to migrate legacy data.
